_comment: Hand-written metadata for Sweden sources, used to build the find_data map. English→Swedish terms live in se.SYNONYMS; `headline` marks the most-asked tables (see eu/hints.json).

sources.SCB: Sweden only; ~2,000 tables with regional detail down to municipality (kommun) and county (län); English titles

SCB.BE/BE0101/BE0101A/BefolkningNy: population inhabitants people by region municipality county age sex marital status annual 1968 to 2024
SCB.BE/BE0101/BE0101A/BefolkningCKM: population inhabitants people by region municipality county age sex marital status annual 2025
SCB.BE/BE0101/BE0101A/BefolkManadCKM: population inhabitants people monthly region age sex latest
SCB.BE/BE0101/BE0101G/MBefStatRegionCKM: population statistics monthly births deaths migration region sex
SCB.BE/BE0101/BE0101H/FoddaK: births live births mother age sex region annual 1968 to 2024
SCB.BE/BE0101/BE0101H/FoddaKCKM: births live births mother age sex region annual 2025
SCB.BE/BE0101/BE0101I/DodaFodelsearK: deaths mortality age sex region annual 1968 to 2024
SCB.BE/BE0101/BE0101I/DodaFodelsearKCKM: deaths mortality age sex region annual 2025
SCB.BE/BE0101/BE0101J/ImmiEmiFlyttN: migration immigration emigration country of origin age sex annual 1968 to 2024
SCB.BE/BE0101/BE0101J/ImmiEmiFlyttNCKM: migration immigration emigration country of origin age sex annual 2025
SCB.AM/AM0401/AM0401A/AKURLBefM: unemployment unemployment rate unemployed jobless employment employed labour force survey labour status monthly
SCB.AM/AM0401/AM0401A/AKURLBefK: unemployment unemployment rate unemployed jobless employment employed labour force survey labour status quarterly
SCB.AM/AM0401/AM0401L/NAKUArblosaTM: unemployed persons duration of unemployment labour force survey monthly
